sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 443.6 ± 29.3 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunofluorescence confirmed both total and surface expression of the FLAG-tagged NPBWR2 TANGO construct; no quantitative functional (ligand-activation) result for NPBWR2 specifically is reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: The canonical NPBWR2 sequence (333 aa) has no signal peptide — residues 1–45 are extracellular per the topology landmarks. The paper prepends an exogenous cleavable signal sequence and a FLAG tag to the 5′-end of the full-length receptor; after signal cleavage the FLAG tag is left at the extracellular N-terminus, corresponding to insert_after_residue = 0 (prepend before residue 1, M). The C-terminus (residues 320–333) is intracellular, making the N-terminus the only extracellular terminus and the only possible location for this tag. The prepend position is 45 residues from TM1 (residue 46), well clear of the ≥3-residue TM-boundary requirement. NPBWR2 TANGO construct engineered with an exogenous cleavable signal sequence followed by a FLAG epitope tag at the 5′-end (N-terminus) of the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor; transfected into cells and examined by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence for total and surface expression.

sources.claim: At the 5′-end, we included a cleavable signal sequence to promote membrane localization 23 and a FLAG epitope tag in order to be able to monitor cell surface expression by immunohistochemistry.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 both describe the same single construct and the same site (N-terminal FLAG in the NPBWR2 TANGO system); L1 is used as the primary supporting clip because it explicitly describes the engineering. No residue number is named in either clip, but the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM GPCR, so the position is topology-derived rather than validated. No ledger evidence supports any internal (ECL1/ECL2/ECL3) insertion for NPBWR2 or a close ortholog, so no internal sites are proposed.
